title: Eleven Years of Letters
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：brother　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 brother 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 my mother was sent to meet ① a brother she could not name, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② brother, meaning the man and not the relation, was thirty years old and was met by whoever came last; a brother, she said, is the only thing in a family that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ brother in that house had the same handwriting, and the ④ brother at the end, meaning the one the mother wrote to and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever answered properly. A brother, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ brother was the whole of the family, meaning the family it carried and not the man. The ⑥ brother, meaning the family and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody claims and nobody questions; a brother, he said, is either someone you meet or the only word that means both a man and a family. She said the family is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ brother had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the handwriting. The ⑧ brother of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was thirty years of patience and eleven years of letters; a brother, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ brother I remember is the one at the end, which was photographed in 1969 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ brother, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being forgiven; every brother, she said, is a family that has agreed to look like a man. She said the family was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 兄弟；哥哥；弟弟
B. n. 兄弟（指那个人本身，与亲戚关系相对）
C. 固定搭配：meet a brother 去接一位兄弟
D. n. 兄弟（指那座房子里每一位）
E. n. 兄弟（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 兄弟（抽象：他所承载的那个家）
G. n. 那个家（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a brother she could not name
The brother, meaning the man and not the relation
brother was the whole of the family
the brother had become a photograph in a report
The brother of the whole thing
A brother, my grandmother said in 1975

answers.why: meet a brother 意为“去接一位兄弟”，1945 年母亲被派去接一位她说不出名字的兄弟。
brother 意为“兄弟”，指那个人本身而不是亲戚关系，三十岁，由最后走的人去接。
brother 指那座房子里每一位兄弟，每一个人都是同样的笔迹。
brother 指末尾那一位（母亲写信的那一位），是唯一有人认真回过信的。
brother 意为“兄弟”，抽象指他所承载的那个家，父亲说 brother 就是那个家的全部。
brother 为抽象用法，指那个家本身，是屋子里人人都认、却没人质疑的东西。
brother 意为“兄弟”，到 1963 年这位 brother 成了报告里的一张照片。
brother 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是三十年的耐心和十一年的书信。
brother 意为“兄弟”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1969 年被拍下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
brother 为抽象总称，祖母说兄弟是唯一会因为被原谅而变好的。

那位兄弟，指的是那个人本身而不是亲戚关系，三十岁，由最后走的人去接。（brother）

1975 年祖母说，兄弟是唯一会因为被原谅而变好的。（brother）

Every brother in that house had the same handwriting.
The brother at the end, meaning the one the mother wrote to and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever answered properly.
My father said brother was the whole of the family, meaning the family it carried and not the man.
A brother, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being forgiven.
